tha-ap210:1.1: Koraṇḍapupphiya.] Akkantañ ca padaṃ disvā cakkālaṅkārabhūsitaṃ / padenānupadaṃ yanto Vipassissa mahesino. // //
tha-ap210:2.1: Koraṇḍaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā samūlaṃ pūjitaṃ mayā / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena avandiṃ padam uttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap210:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi padapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap210:4.1: Sattapaññāsakappamhi eko Vītamalo ahū / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap210:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Koraṇḍapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
